Type: flowchart

Boxes/entities:
- Training data
- Generator, G (Multilayer neural network)
- Discriminator, D (Multilayer neural network)
- Random noise

Connections:
- Random noise -> Generator, G
- Training data -> Discriminator, D ("real" samples)
- Generator, G -> Discriminator, D (Generated "fake" samples)
- Discriminator, D -> Discriminator loss (Backpropagation)
- Generator, G -> Generator loss (Backpropagation)
